delta_over_0_1_1.summary: 0.2.0 = 0.1.1 + the 0.2 feature waves (auto-format engine §6, recipient-grade self-contained HTML export §7, QoL set §9) merged to main via PRs #12-#23, rebuilt/retested/repackaged on both platforms with the locked xtask driver. The release commit itself is the version bump only.

feature_wave_merges.title: Wave 1E themed self-contained HTML export + allowlist sanitizer
Wave 2S shared reducer plumbing for shell integration
Wave 3V tastecheck design pass on HTML export template
Wave 3B ChangeSet return + incremental shell apply
UltraQA round 2 — O(n^2) list-paste hang + format-engine boundary panic
Wave 4 code-review findings (HIGH replace-all cursor + 3 MEDIUM)
